# ankra_ai_model (Resource)

An entry in the organisation's AI model catalogue: a model the chat picker offers and auto-routing can target. The counterpart of `ankra ai models create`, `update` and `delete`.

An organisation that never changed its catalogue is served the built-in `expert`, `think` and `quick` entries. The first entry Terraform creates stores those built-ins as ordinary entries next to it, so creating one with a built-in key fails; import a built-in by its key (`terraform import ankra_ai_model.expert expert`) to manage it instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_ai_endpoint" "litellm" {
  name     = "litellm"
  base_url = "https://litellm.example.com/v1"
  api_key  = var.litellm_api_key
}

resource "ankra_ai_model" "gpt" {
  key                   = "gpt-4o"
  display_name          = "GPT-4o"
  model_id              = "gpt-4o"
  endpoint_id           = ankra_ai_endpoint.litellm.id
  context_window_tokens = 128000
  supports_images       = true
}

variable "litellm_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the model picker.
- `key` (String) Catalogue key, the value a chat's model mode selects: lower-case letters, digits, `-` and `_`. `auto` is reserved.
- `model_id` (String) Provider model id, for example `claude-opus-5` or `gpt-4o`.

### Optional

- `context_window_tokens` (Number) Context window in tokens, 8192 to 2000000. The platform defaults it to 200000.
- `description` (String) Short description.
- `endpoint_id` (String) `ankra_ai_endpoint` the model is served from. Unset routes the model through the Ankra-managed Claude route.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the model is selectable. Defaults to `true`.
- `max_output_tokens` (Number) Maximum output tokens, 256 to 200000 and below the context window. The platform defaults it to 8192.
- `sort_order` (Number) Position in the picker, lowest first. Defaults to `0`.
- `supports_images` (Boolean) Whether the model accepts image inputs. Defaults to `false`.
- `supports_thinking` (Boolean) Whether the model has a thinking or reasoning channel. Defaults to `false`.
- `supports_tools` (Boolean) Whether the model supports tool calling. Defaults to `true`.
- `tier` (String) Auto-routing tier: `expert`, `think` or `quick`. Unset makes the model reachable only by explicit selection.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Row identifier of the entry; null for a built-in entry the organisation has not changed yet.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether the key is one of the built-in tier keys.
- `provider_kind` (String) `ankra` for the Ankra-managed route, `openai_compatible` for a model on an endpoint.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Catalogue entries are imported by row id, or by key. A built-in entry the
# organisation never changed (expert, think, quick) has only its key.
terraform import ankra_ai_model.gpt 7d1e2c4a-3b5f-4e6d-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b
terraform import ankra_ai_model.expert expert
```
